content.title: NYT Connections Hints Today (#1030)—Answers for Monday, April 6
content.text: It’s a whole new week, and that means you’re presented with seven more chances to keep pushing that NYT Connections streak even further! In this guide, you’ll find the NYT Connections hints and answers you need to get today’s challenge completed as quickly as possible. Simply read on, get the NYT Connections solutions you need, and start your week the right way! How to Play NYT Connections In June 2023, NYT Connections emerged as yet another game in the ever-growing lineup of the New York Times titles. This title soared immediately, and it’s easy to see why. As a free-to-play, accessible New York Times game, NYT Connections is available worldwide and can be played on desktop devices or in a mobile app. But how do you play NYT Connections? The NYT team will provide you with a grid of 16 words once a day. The only task left up to you is to sort those words into four groups of four by finding their commonalities. Every NYT Connections puzzle has just one solution, and some words can have double meanings, so it can sometimes be tricky to figure out the answers. It’s also important to stress that the words are color-coded: yellow, blue, green, and purple. That’s in order of difficulty, from least to most. What’s critical here is that you get four guesses every day, and if you use those, your NYT Connections answers for today will be out of reach, as it’ll be game over. Today’s NYT Connections Hints (April 6) Here are the words from today’s NYT Connections puzzle: SHARE OLIVES MALLET HOP MOLE WICKET BALL STAKE HOLES RAVE CAROUSER CONCERN EVITE CLAIM TIMER HOEDOWN And here are the hints I can offer for today’s NYT Connections: Yellow – Words for events that feature dancing and music Green – Words to describe having an interest in something Blue – Words you’d associate with a fun game of Whack-a-Mole Purple – Classic musicals with a slight amendment Here’s the final warning before we get to the NYT Connections answers for today, April 6: Are you sure you want to scroll further? Very well! NYT Connections Answers Explained for Today, April 6 (#1030) If you want to jump straight to the answers for today’s NYT Connections puzzle, I’ve got you covered: Yellow – BALL, HOEDOWN, HOP, RAVE Green – CLAIM, CONCERN, SHARE, STAKE Blue – HOLES, MALLET, MOLE, TIMER Purple – CAROUSER, EVITE, OLIVES, WICKET When Does NYT Connections Reset? That’s today’s puzzle, but if you want the next one, the game resets daily at midnight local time (that’s your local time). You’ll have 24 hours to complete the puzzle when midnight ticks over in your timezone. How did you do? Did you get a perfect run?
